[SWS_SwCluC_03509] The Com High Proxy shall provide the function for trans-
mission request of a signal
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00211
⌈The Com High Proxy shall provide the function for transmission request of a sig-
nal, according to [SWS_SwCluC_03506], once per configured SwCluCComProxy-
BaseSocket.
At the EcucPartition, where the SwCluCNativeBswApi is set
to true, the API is provided with the original Mip Com.
For all other SwCluC-
ComProxy
